description: Reads a client's 1040 source documents and emits a worksheet of totals keyed to Form 1040 and schedule line numbers.
_doc: In-tree manifest for KisaesDevLab/Vibe-1040 (github.com/KisaesDevLab/Vibe-1040), current release v0.0.1. THREE containers plus a migration one-shot, from two GHCR images: `vibe-1040` runs the Fastify api (8240, and the React review UI it serves at its own root), the BullMQ worker, and the migration one-shot; `vibe-1040-sidecar` is the Python PyMuPDF rasterization worker, which talks to nothing over HTTP - it takes work off the shared Redis and shares the encrypted blob store on disk. THE ROUTER IS A HARD DEPENDENCY: the app's env schema requires a non-empty VIBE_AI_TOKEN, so with vibe-ai-router down even the migration step throws at config-parse time. That is what requiredApps encodes. See also the ROUTER_REQUIRE_US_REGION note in env-templates/per-app/vibe-1040.env.tmpl - the appliance ships it OFF because the router has no region concept yet, and the app fails closed when it is on. MIGRATIONS: This app has no MIGRATIONS_AUTO knob and its server never migrates on boot, so the appliance owns migrations outright - update.sh runs this command with its pre-update dump and health-check rollback behind it. Enable-time migration comes from the overlay's vibe-1040-migrate one-shot instead, which every other service in the set waits on via service_completed_successfully. FIRST LOGIN: Verified against src/db/seed.ts in the upstream repo: it reads SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL / SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment, is a no-op when the user already exists, and deliberately does NOT pre-enrol MFA.

required.name: VIBE_AI_ROUTER_URL
required.doc: The router's /v1 gateway on vibe_net. Never route this through Caddy - it is a server-to-server call inside the appliance and the gateway has no public vhost.

required.name: VIBE_AI_TOKEN
required.doc: App token minted against the vibe-ai-router admin API during enable, then preserved across re-renders (minting again would orphan the old row). This app has no direct-provider fallback: it holds no provider credentials at all, so an empty token means it does not boot.

required.name: TIN_HASH_SALT
required.doc: 32 raw bytes, base64. Salts the taxpayer-identification hash that forms the client join key. NOT ROTATABLE IN PLACE - changing it orphans every taxpayer record already stored. Generated once on first enable and preserved on every re-render; it lives in /opt/vibe/env, which is inside the appliance's sealed backup set.

required.name: SESSION_SECRET
required.doc: 32 raw bytes, base64. Signs staff session cookies. Per-app rather than the appliance-wide JWT_SECRET because this app's zod schema requires exactly 32 decoded bytes and rotating it should sign out this app only.

required.name: STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
required.doc: 32 raw bytes, base64. AES-256-GCM at rest for the local blob driver - source documents and rasterized page images both. Losing it loses every stored page. Generated once and preserved, same contract as TIN_HASH_SALT.

required.name: SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD
required.doc: First-login password for the staff admin the appliance's seed step creates. Surfaced in the console's First-login card and in /opt/vibe/CREDENTIALS.txt. Generated once and preserved so a re-enable never invalidates the password the operator wrote down.

required.name: ROUTER_REQUIRE_US_REGION
required.doc: Compliance guardrail. When true the app asserts at startup that the router reports US-region pinning for its three task classes and REFUSES TO START otherwise. As of vibe-ai-router v0.0.2 there is no region concept to report, so leaving it true means the app never boots. The appliance ships it false and says so in the env template; see that file for what you are accepting.

required.name: STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH
required.doc: Blob root inside every container of this app. Bind-mounted from /opt/vibe/data/apps/vibe-1040/blobs, shared by the api, the worker, and the Python sidecar - which is why this app declares dataOwner.

optional.name: VIBE_APP_SUBDOMAIN
optional.doc: Operator override for this app's subdomain label. Empty = the manifest default. Consumed by the appliance routing (Caddy vhost + Cloudflare Tunnel CNAME/ingress). This app is rootServedOnly, so it gets its own hostname in domain mode under BOTH routing modes. Single DNS label - lowercase letters, digits, dashes, no dots.

ui.label: Subdomain
ui.helpText: The <subdomain> in <subdomain>.<your-domain> for this app. Leave blank to use the built-in default. Lowercase letters, digits, and dashes; no dots. Saving re-renders routing and re-provisions the Cloudflare Tunnel; the app briefly restarts.

optional.name: SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL
optional.doc: Login for the staff admin created by the seed step. Set this BEFORE first enable if you want a real address - the seed runs exactly once (state.apps.vibe-1040.seeded gates it), so changing it later creates nothing and the original login stays. Add further staff from inside the app under Admin -> Users.

ui.label: First staff admin email
ui.helpText: The email you sign in with the first time. Set it before you enable the app - afterwards the account already exists and this field does nothing.

optional.name: RECONCILE_TOLERANCE_CENTS
optional.doc: Per-document rounding tolerance, in cents, for the arithmetic gate that decides whether a worksheet may be produced. Widening it hides real disagreements between a form's stated subtotal and the sum of its parts.

ui.label: Reconciliation tolerance (cents)
ui.helpText: How far a document's arithmetic may be off before the bundle is held for review. Default 100 (one dollar). Do not widen this to make a stubborn document pass.

optional.name: EXTRACT_PASSES
optional.doc: How many independent extraction passes run per document. Multi-pass agreement is the only confidence signal available, so 1 means no confidence signal at all. Each pass costs another inference call.

ui.label: Extraction passes
ui.helpText: Independent reads of each document, compared against each other. 2 is the default; 1 disables the agreement check entirely; 3 costs more and catches a little more.

optional.name: RETENTION_RASTER_DAYS
optional.doc: Days a rasterized page image is kept. Page images are derived PII and the app refuses to start if this exceeds RETENTION_DOCUMENT_DAYS.

ui.label: Page-image retention (days)
ui.helpText: How long rendered page images live before the retention job purges them. Must not exceed the source-document retention below - the app refuses to start if it does.

optional.name: RETENTION_DOCUMENT_DAYS
optional.doc: Days a source document is kept. Default 2555 (seven years).

ui.label: Source-document retention (days)
ui.helpText: How long uploaded client documents live before the retention job purges them. Default 2555 (seven years).

optional.name: TZ
optional.doc: IANA time-zone name (e.g. America/Chicago). Inherits the appliance-wide TZ unless overridden.

ui.label: Time zone (override)
ui.helpText: Inherited from appliance. Override only if this firm operates in a different zone than the host.

firstLogin.note: The username is whatever SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL was at enable time. MFA IS MANDATORY and cannot be turned off: the session is unusable until you complete second-factor enrolment on this first sign-in, and an authenticator app (TOTP) is the only factor that needs no further configuration - emailed and texted codes require SMTP or SMS to be set up first. Change the password after signing in; the appliance's seed runs once and will not reset it again, not even on disable/re-enable. This app is served at the ROOT of its own subdomain in both routing modes (its bundle cannot be path-mounted; see rootServedOnly), so in LAN/Tailscale mode use http://<server-ip>:5177/ instead.

seed.description: Creates the first staff admin from SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL / SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD. No demo data, no pre-enrolled MFA secret.
